references.text: A prophecy from Moses that God will raise up a prophet among their brothers, like him (Moses), whom the people should listen to.
The fulfillment of the prophecy that the Messiah would be called a Nazarene.

The fulfillment of the prophecy from Isaiah about the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, the way to the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles—the people who sat in darkness have seen a great light.
